chunks: Ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Abū Ayyūb, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman in iʿtikāf when she menstruates, he said:
“She returns to her home, and when she becomes pure, she returns and makes up what is upon her.”

key_terms.فَقَضَتْ: she makes up or completes later
key_terms.مَا عَلَيْهَا: what she is obligated to complete
key_terms.ٱلْمُعْتَكِفَةِ: a woman observing iʿtikāf, the spiritual retreat in the mosque

ai.seo_question: What should a woman do if menstruation begins while she is in iʿtikāf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a woman performing iʿtikāf who begins menstruating. She must leave for her home, and after attaining ritual purity, she returns and completes what she owes from the iʿtikāf.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2106 - It is narrated by Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a woman performing i'tikaf who experiences menstruation.
She should return to her home, and when she becomes pure, she should return and make up for what she missed."
